notes: Table 1110, Deciles of income before taxes, Consumer Expenditure Surveys 2024 (BLS, published Dec 2025). All figures are ANNUAL MEANS per consumer unit (not medians). income_after_tax is null because Table 1110 does not report after-tax income by decile (only the top-line means table 'cu-all-detail' reports 'Income after taxes' for ALL consumer units combined: $87,869 in 2023 vintage; 2024 all-CU after-tax figure was not captured in this pull — left null rather than guessed). CATEGORY MAPPING: housing = Shelter + Utilities/fuels/public services + Household operations + Housekeeping supplies + Household furnishings & equipmentthis is BLS's full 'Housing' major category. food_at_home / food_away are BLS's own subcategories of 'Food'. healthcare_oop = BLS 'Healthcare' major category (health insurance premiums + medical services + drugs + medical supplies) -- this includes both premiums and true out-of-pocket, per BLS methodology (BLS does not further split premium vs true OOP cost in this table). transport_total = BLS 'Transportation' major category. transport_work is NOT a BLS-published subtotal -- it is CONSTRUCTED here as vehicle purchases (net outlay) + gasoline & other fuels + maintenance & repairs + vehicle insurance, excluding public/other transportation, vehicle finance charges, and vehicle rental/lease/license fees; this is a reasonable proxy for 'cost of owning/running a vehicle for work' but is an approximation, not an official BLS category -- treat with caution. apparel = BLS 'Apparel and services'. communications = BLS 'Telephone services' line item only (residential + cellular combined) -- BLS does not have a standalone broadband/internet line in these summary tables (internet often falls under 'Audio and visual equipment and services' within Entertainment, not broken out); this understates true communications spend. personal_care = BLS 'Personal care products and services'. education = BLS 'Reading' + BLS 'Education' summed (per v2 schema's combined 'reading + education' category). cash_contributions = BLS 'Cash contributions'. voluntary_savings = BLS 'Retirement, pensions, and Social Security' sub-line under 'Personal insurance and pensions' -- IMPORTANT: this BLS line includes mandatory Social Security payroll tax contributions AND voluntary employer-sponsored retirement plan contributions (401k, etc.) blended together; BLS does not separate them. The v2 pipeline will need to subtract an estimated mandatory FICA OASDI share (6.2% of wages up to the wage base) if a true 'voluntary savings' figure is needed -- flagged for the client-side necessity/savings calculator. entertainment = BLS 'Entertainment' major category. housing_owner_share = percent of consumer units in that decile who are homeowners (BLS 'Homeowner' percent distribution row). housing_owner_imputed_rent_estimate = BLS's 'Estimated monthly rental value of owned home' addendum line, ANNUALIZED (x12) here for consistency with other annual figures -- this is BLS's own imputed rent estimate for owner-occupied housing, averaged across ALL consumer units in the decile (owners and renters combined), not just owners. Lower/upper income bounds per decile (not carried into this file) are in the source table's 'Lower limit' row if needed later.
